business_overview.one_sentence: The Group provides branding, advertising and marketing services and advertisement placement services in the PRC.
business_overview.revenue_model: Branding and event services are generally recognised over time; advertisement placement and certain online advertising services are recognised on a net basis under HKFRS 15.
business_notes: All revenue was derived in the PRC and all non-current assets were located in the PRC for 2023 and 2022.
No external customer contributed over 10% of total revenue in 2023 or 2022.
The company listed on HKEX on 10 November 2023.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Profit-to-cash conversion is weak: FY2023 operating cash flow was RMB23.887m versus adjusted profit of about RMB80.728m, while FY2022 operating cash flow was negative. Trade receivables increased by RMB148.670m in FY2023 and trade payables also increased by RMB76.991m, so the cash result depends heavily on working capital timing.

evidence.detail: Consolidated financial statements are presented in RMB and rounded to nearest thousand
RMB is not freely convertible and RMB balances are held by PRC subsidiaries
Net listing proceeds HKD72.14m; HKD17.3m utilised by 31 December 2023; remaining proceeds intended for 2024 uses
No pledged assets, no significant contingent liabilities, no material investments

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by parent company, Hong Kong holding company and individual PRC operating subsidiaries beyond currency disclosure.
No explicit restricted cash balance was found; absence of a line item is treated as no disclosed restricted cash, not proof that all cash is distributable.
The annual report provides 2021 profit summary but not a full 2021 cash flow statement in this file.
Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; FY2023 purchase of plant and equipment is used as a conservative proxy.
